name: distal myopathy with vocal cord weakness
description: Distal myopathy with vocal cord and pharyngeal weakness is an adult-onset, autosomal dominant muscular disease which is characterized by muscle weakness in the feet and hands, combined with vocal or swallowing dysfunction.
